items.name: minim-icons
items.title: Minim Icons
items.description: 20 customizable Minim interface icons with default and selected variants.
items.author: Minim
items.docs: Import any named icon component, or use MinimIcon with a name. Pass variant="selected" for its selected artwork and customize it with standard SVG props or Tailwind classes.
